title: 第25章 李浪成鬼神了第26章 针对与暴露
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
袅袅燃烧的青烟，像是一条蜿蜒出潜渊的青龙，笔直的冲出深峡，穿破云流，直入九霄！
点燃的烛火，逐渐清晰的“四目观音镇鬼童像”
，模糊的画面，好似在李浪的精神之中，慢慢的烙印而出。
这是……
拜鬼神的仪式画面！
虽然李浪没有拜过鬼神，但是，在云霄城，拜鬼神之事在百姓之中，乃是极其重要且郑重的事情，甚至衍生成为了习俗。
但是……
这拜鬼神，为什么变成拜他李浪了啊？
他李浪……成鬼神了？！
左胸腔内，鲁班锁加以榫卯结构铸就的心脏，张合怦然！
开启的三格鲁班锁中，第二格锁收录了“四目观音镇鬼童像”
，被李浪命名为“雕像锁”
，负责雕像分类。
而这尊木雕，乃是周屠夫预定的，所以，将木雕交付给了周屠夫后，雕像锁之中，自然空荡荡。
可此刻，竟是有清气，如丝如缕的凭空溢散而出。
像是拜鬼神香柱燃烧的烟气！
李浪呼吸不禁急促起来，看着慢慢凝聚而起的袅袅烟气，勾勒出了一尊模糊的雕像模样，正是那四目观音镇鬼神像！
这不是收录到神工之心内的基础白色清气，而是一种特殊的能量。
“这是……鬼神之力？”
李浪眸光一亮，抬起手，拍在了心口。

顿时，神工之心怦然，汲取自唐宇身上的那半截鬼神纹顿时浮现而出，像是游蛇一般，从机关锁中窜出，钻入到了雕像锁内。
在李浪的内视感知中，开始贪婪的吞噬着那组成观音像的烟气。
烟气被完全汲吞，那半截鬼神纹，竟像是抖擞一般，慢慢甩动着，逐渐生长圆满，成了一道完整的鬼神纹！
这被别人当做鬼神来拜后，所得获的鬼神之力，竟是极其精纯！
唐宇的半截鬼神纹，只是汲吞后，便直接圆满！
若是换算成鬼神修为，等于说他直接从半步凝纹，直接正式踏足一道凝纹境！
这让李浪意外且惊喜！
因为，他并未觉醒鬼神纹，也就是说，他根本无法汲取鬼神之力进入体内，来壮大与加持鬼神纹。
可如今，他好像寻到了另外的壮大鬼神纹的路径！
等于说，他另辟出一条成为鬼神修士的蹊径！
而且，李浪觉得，能这么快就从半步凝纹提升到一道凝纹，这“雕像锁”
内凝聚的鬼神之力，该是何等的精纯啊！
比起“鬼神币”
中的鬼神之力都要精纯的多！
李浪压下心头的惊喜，雕像锁内，随着烟气凝聚的观音像，被汲吞完了能量，隐约间，只剩下个好似极其模糊的勾勒线条。
像是一个透明琉璃打造的空壳摆放在里面般。
宛若拜鬼神后，所留下的……鬼神空壳！
李浪看着这个空壳。
content_en:
The burning green smoke is like a green dragon winding out of the abyss, rushing straight out of the deep gorge, breaking through the clouds, and straight into the sky!
The lit candles gradually became clearer as the "Four-Eyed Guanyin Town Ghost Child Statue"
, the blurry picture seemed to be slowly imprinted in Li Lang's spirit.
This is...
Pictures of rituals for worshiping ghosts and gods!
Although Li Lang has never worshiped ghosts and gods, in Yunxiao City, worshiping ghosts and gods is an extremely important and solemn matter among the people, and has even become a custom.
But...
Why did you worship Li Lang instead of worshiping ghosts and gods?
He Li Lang...has become a ghost? !
In the left chest cavity, the heart made of Luban Suo and mortise and tenon structure opened and closed with a bang!
Among the three open locks, the second lock contains the "Four-Eyed Guanyin Town Ghost Child Statue"
, named "Statue Lock" by Li Lang
, responsible for the classification of statues.
This wooden sculpture was ordered by Butcher Zhou, so after delivering the wooden sculpture to Butcher Zhou, the statue was naturally empty within the lock.
But at this moment, there was actually fresh air, flowing out of the air like threads.
Like the smoke from burning incense sticks worshiping ghosts and gods!
Li Lang couldn't help but breathe quickly. Looking at the smoke that slowly gathered, a vague statue was outlined. It was the four-eyed Guanyin statue to suppress ghosts and gods!
This is not the basic white Qi contained in the Heart of Divine Works, but a special kind of energy.
"This is...the power of ghosts and gods?"
Li Lang's eyes lit up, he raised his hand and patted his heart.
Suddenly, the heart of the divine craftsman was pounding, and the half of the ghost and god patterns drawn from Tang Yu's body suddenly emerged, like a snake, escaping from the machine lock and getting into the statue lock.
In Li Lang's inner vision, he began to greedily swallow the smoke that made up the Guanyin statue.
The smoke was completely swallowed up, and the half of the ghost and god pattern seemed to be shaking, slowly swinging, and gradually grew to perfection, becoming a complete ghost and god pattern!
After being worshiped by others as a ghost and god, the power of the ghost and god obtained is actually extremely pure!
Half of Tang Yu's ghost and god patterns were immediately completed after swallowing!
If converted into the cultivation level of ghosts and gods, it is equivalent to saying that he directly stepped into the realm of condensing patterns from half a step of condensing patterns!
This surprised and surprised Li Lang!
Because he has not awakened the ghost and god patterns, that is to say, he cannot absorb the power of ghosts and gods into his body to strengthen and strengthen the ghost and god patterns.
But now, he seems to have found another way to strengthen the ghost and god patterns!
It is equivalent to saying that he has found another way to become a ghost and god monk!
Moreover, Li Lang felt that this "statue lock" could be upgraded from a half-step condensation pattern to a single condensation pattern so quickly.
The power of ghosts and gods condensed within must be so pure!
Compared with "Ghost Coin"
The power of ghosts and gods in it is much more pure!
Li Lang suppressed the surprise in his heart. Inside the statue lock, as the smoke condensed, the Avalokitesvara statue had been drained of all its energy, leaving only vaguely vague outlines.
It's like an empty shell made of transparent glass placed inside.
Just like what is left after worshiping ghosts and gods...the empty shells of ghosts and gods!
Li Lang looked at this empty shell.
